title: 第7章 收钱不办事第8章 军魂不灭
lines: 全公公扫了一眼满朝文武，然后用尖细的声音念道：
“醉里挑灯看剑，梦回吹角连营。
八百里分麾下炙，五十弦翻塞外声，沙场秋点兵。
马作的卢飞快，弓如霹雳弦惊。
了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名，可怜白发生！”
当全公公念完，原本安静地朝堂，就像是平静的水面投下一颗炸弹。
文武百官全都惊呆了！
尤其是文官，一个个激动的面色潮红。
身为文人，谁不想有一首绝世佳作，万世流传？
武将虽然没文官那么有学问，但也能听出这首词中的意境。
他们眼前好似出现一幅画面，一位白发苍苍的年迈老将，对着自己封存已久的宝剑苦闷叹息。
将军迟暮，美人白发，都是人生憾事。
“陛下，敢问这首词乃是何人所作？”
翰林院掌院，李瀚儒，激动的胡子乱颤。
他一定要知道这个人是谁？
他作了一辈子的诗词，比起这首词来，他都不配提笔。
文武百官，都一脸希冀地看着玄帝。
玄帝皱眉，“怎么？这首词就不是能朕所作？”
众人不信。
玄帝文学修养很高，但这首词写的是将军迟暮的那种无力感，肯定不是玄帝所作。
“陛下深居皇宫，写不出如此有意境的词。”
一个耿直的言官直接说了出来。
这可把玄帝气得不轻，差点没忍住用龙案上的焚香炉砸死他。
这些言官真的是太讨厌了！
陈老将军一脸激动，这首词完美的描述了他现在的心情，可惜他嘴笨，也没文化...写这首词的人，简直就是他嘴替，知音！
“陛下，老臣也想知道，这首词乃是何人所作？”
玄帝淡淡地说道：“这首词乃是朕偶然所得，作者乃是一位十几岁的少年郎，名叫蓝星。”
满朝文武，再次惊呆了。
作者是一位十几岁的少年郎？
这怎么可能？
一个少年郎，怎么能写出如此意境的词？
content_en:
Eunuch Quan glanced at the civil and military officials of the court, and then read in a high-pitched voice:
"When I was drunk, I read the sword with the light on, and I dreamed about the trumpet-blowing camp.
Eight hundred miles away, the troops under his command are burning, the sound of fifty-stringed strings turning outside the Great Wall, and the troops on the battlefield being ordered in autumn.
The horse moves very fast, and the bow is as frightening as a thunderbolt.
To end the affairs of the king and the world, to gain fame both in life and in death, all the misfortune happened in vain! "
When Grandfather Quan finished reciting, he was sitting quietly in the hall, as if a bomb was dropped on the calm water.
All civil and military officials were shocked!
Especially the civil servants, their faces flushed with excitement.
As a literati, who doesn’t want to have a masterpiece that will be passed down forever?
Although military generals are not as knowledgeable as civil servants, they can still hear the artistic conception of this poem.
A picture seemed to appear in front of them. A white-haired old veteran sighed in agony at his long-sealed sword.
The general's old age and the beauty's gray hair are all regrets in life.
"Your Majesty, may I ask who composed this poem?"
The head of the Hanlin Academy, Li Hanru, had his beard trembling with excitement.
He must know who this person is?
He has written poems all his life, but compared to this poem, he is not worthy of writing.
All the civil and military officials looked at Emperor Xuan expectantly.
Emperor Xuan frowned, "What? Couldn't this poem be composed by me?"
Everyone didn't believe it.
Emperor Xuan had a high level of literary accomplishment, but this poem describes the general's feeling of powerlessness in Chi Mu, and was definitely not written by Emperor Xuan.
"Your Majesty lives deep in the palace and cannot write such meaningful words."
An upright speaker said it directly.
This made Emperor Xuan so angry that he almost couldn't help but smash him to death with the incense burner on the dragon table.
These commentators are really annoying!
Old General Chen looked excited. This poem perfectly describes his current mood. Unfortunately, he is stupid and uneducated... The person who wrote this poem is simply his substitute and close friend!
"Your Majesty, I also want to know who wrote this poem?"
Emperor Xuan said calmly: "I got this poem by chance. The author is a teenage boy named Lan Xing."
All the civil and military officials in the court were shocked again.
Is the author a teenage boy?
How is this possible?
How could a young man write words with such artistic conception?
title_en: Chapter 7: Collecting money but not doing anything Chapter 8: The spirit of the army is immortal
